author: goldenwalrus909
body:
Hey, Goldie here :3

So, I'm about to go to bed and I decided I should make this post. I just wanted to say "My replies" is pretty misleading and isn't the most used (I don't believe) feature of the website. How about instead of making "My Replies" the comments that other people made on the same topic you commented on, we make them the comments that reply to your comment (Example: If I say "Pie is amazing." and someone comments saying "Yeah, but ice cream is better," then I'd get a 1 beside my reply box and once I click on it and go to the topic,  I can see the reply.). I think in order to see comments like that, we should make a link that's titled "Subscriptions" under the "My Replies". Once you subscribe to an article and someone comments on it, there will be a notification like the one next to "My Replies" that will tell you how many comments you've gotten since you last checked your subscribed topics. I think that this will make the most out of the forums and will greater improve the website. If you have any criticism, approval, or ideas, then please comment below, just like usual! :3

-Love, Goldie
